value.name: Asha retrieves binder from drawer
value.description: Asha goes to the night aide's desk, opens the drawer, and takes out the binder Lucia said would be there.
evidence: Asha crossed to the night aide's small desk by the door and slid open the drawer.
The binder was where Lucia had said it would be, its plastic spine softened from handling, and she lifted it out
value.location_hint: night aide's small desk by the door

value.name: Asha places binder on Lucia's knee
value.description: Asha brings the binder back and sets it on Lucia's knee over the half-page, leaving the Wynnewood line visible.
evidence: brought it back to the chair, setting it across Lucia's knee on top of the half-page so that the Wynnewood line still showed at the edge

value.name: Lucia asks about transport arrangements
value.description: Lucia looks up and quietly asks who will handle the transport, signaling concern about the move.
evidence: Lucia rested her hand flat on the cover but did not open it; instead she looked up at Asha for the first time since sitting down and asked, almost too quietly to carry, who handles the transport.

value.name: Asha interprets Lucia's question
value.description: Asha realizes Lucia is really asking whether she will be in the car when their mother is moved.
evidence: Asha understood the question was not really about the van or the morning route — it was whether she would be in the car when their mother was moved

value.name: Asha promises to follow to Wynnewood
value.description: Asha answers before the silence can widen, saying she will drive out after closing and follow Lucia to Wynnewood.
evidence: she made herself answer before the pause could turn into the old shape between them, saying she would drive out after the closing and follow Lucia to Wynnewood

value.name: Asha offers to ride with mother on move day
value.description: Asha adds that if the bed lasts until Sunday, she will ride with their mother on the day of the move.
evidence: and that if the bed held past Sunday she would be the one to ride with their mother on the day of the move

value.name: Lucia silently accepts Asha's answer
value.description: Lucia keeps her hand on the binder, nods once, and does not let go, showing restrained acceptance.
evidence: Lucia's hand stayed on the binder, and she nodded once, and did not let go of it

value.name: Asha closes binder over hidden page
value.description: Asha folds the binder shut over the half-page and presses it flat under Lucia's hands so the Wynnewood line is no longer visible.
evidence: Asha reached down and folded the binder shut over the half-page, pressing the cover flat under Lucia's palms so the Wynnewood line was no longer visible at the edge, only felt through the plastic

value.name: Lucia shifts binder aside and checks clock
value.description: Lucia lets her hands remain briefly, then slides the binder toward Asha and glances at the wall clock, preparing to ask another question.
evidence: Lucia let her hands stay where Asha had placed them for a moment, then slid the binder a few inches toward Asha's side of her lap and glanced past her at the wall clock above the aide's desk
